title: AutoIndexer：通过编辑链训练因果模型的灵活顺序解码
summary: AutoIndexer 提出一种新的训练与解码机制，模拟“编辑链”，让模型能通过插入、替换、删除标记灵活修改已生成的输出，类似文本编辑器移动光标。训练序列由真实标签经逆向链式编辑扰动生成，模型学习撤销这些逆操作。该方法具备自回归和扩散模型缺乏的生成后上下文编辑能力，且不损失标准基准性能。
summary_en: AutoIndexer introduces a novel training and decoding mechanism simulating a Chain of Edits, letting models flexibly modify prior outputs via token insertions, substitutions, and deletions like a text editor cursor. Training sequences are built by perturbing ground-truth labels with inverse chained edits, and the model learns to undo them. It enables post-generation context editing that autoregressive and diffusion models lack, without hurting standard benchmark performance.
